prompt:
Repaint the building on the grass tile as a clean reference picture for a 3D modeller. Keep exactly the same design, the same parts, the same proportions and the same colours, and leave out the grass tile it stands on: a square keep of plain smooth warm cream stone with square battlements on top, a royal blue flag on a pole, and a long royal blue banner hanging down its front face, a small wooden door and small dark windows. Royal blue is only on the flag and the banner.

Three-quarter view from the front left and a little from above, the whole object in frame and centred, filling about 70 percent of the picture. Plain flat light grey background. No grass tile, no ground, no floor, no cast shadow. Soft even light from the front. Crisp clean outlines and smooth painted surfaces without brush texture. Only this one building, no text, no other objects.
label: base.2 three-quarter view
